meta.title: Coaches — REP | IV | Verified Coaching Jobs & Leadership Roles
meta.description: A free, verified job board for coaches at every level. Coaching roles with schools, colleges, clubs and pro programs — plus leadership roles in business. You control who can contact you.

hero.headline: Lead the next
hero.subheadline: You build culture, develop people and get results under pressure. REP | IV connects you with coaching roles and leadership opportunities from verified employers.

items.title: A free, verified profile
items.body: Your coaching career, your credentials, your philosophy — presented to verified employers who have already been reviewed by our team. No subscription, no fee, ever.

items.title: Coaching jobs at every level
items.body: Roles with schools, colleges, clubs and pro programs. From youth development to professional staff positions — every posting comes from a verified employer.

items.title: Leadership roles in business
items.body: The skills that make a great coach — developing people, building culture, performing under pressure — are exactly what companies hire for. We help you make that case.

items.title: You control who can contact you
items.body: Employers send a connection request. Your phone number and email are never shared until you say yes. Every conversation starts on your terms.

whoCanJoin.headline: Every level,
whoCanJoin.body: REP | IV is for coaches at every level — youth, high school, college, club and professional. Verification is straightforward: a link to a staff page, a program website, or a reference from a verified member already on REP | IV.
whoCanJoin.note: Everyone on REP | IV is verified before they can connect with employers.

roles.headline: Where coaches
roles.body: From on-field roles to front-office and business leadership, here are the kinds of positions coaches find on REP | IV.

neverPay.headline: Never pay
neverPay.body: Employers can never charge you for anything — not to apply, not to get hired, not for certifications, clinics or access. If anyone asks you for money, report it immediately.
